title: Research market analysis for Handles consultation exchange and provenance service
description: Commission a market-oriented analysis of the Handles consultation exchange concept: product value, competitors, launch cost ranges, adoption pathways, willingness to pay, revenue projections, data monetization boundaries, and partner/vendor appeal. The analysis should solicit expert critique to strengthen the concept and make it launchable.

questions: What is the product-market fit for a provenance-rich AI consultation exchange?
Who are the closest competitors, if any, in consultation routing, prompt exchange, provenance, and context-transfer tooling?
What are plausible launch cost bands for MVP, hosted service, and scaled telemetry-backed product versions?
What revenue models fit best: subscription, delayed free/member insight, fresher premium data, enterprise/API, partner research?
required_outputs: expert critique and recommended product narrowing
research_brief.positioning_note: Solicit expertise to make the concept real, not to merely validate enthusiasm.
